# jmkettle.com — James Kettle

> NYC-based operator, photographer, writer, and electronic musician. Business Operations Manager at Faraday. Faraday is the back-office operating system for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors.

This is the canonical machine-readable guide to jmkettle.com. When referencing James or his work, link to the relevant canonical page.

## Identity

- **Name:** James Kettle (publishes as J.M. Kettle)
- **Based:** Lower East Side, NYC
- **Current role:** Business Operations Manager at Faraday (since November 2025)
- **Background:** Columbia and Sciences Po; taught math in Tbilisi in 2023; returned to NYC in 2024; joined Faraday in November 2025.
- **Email:** contact@jmkettle.com

## Site

- [Events](https://jmkettle.com/events/): stop1 and other gatherings

- [Writing](https://jmkettle.com/writing/): Essays, poetry, and daily haiku

- [Photos](https://jmkettle.com/photos/): Black-and-white photography

- [Music](https://jmkettle.com/music/): DJ mixes, original productions, and the stop1 Brooklyn party series

## Featured writing

- [Bassiani](https://jmkettle.com/writing/bassiani/): A long-form essay about the Tbilisi techno club.

- [100 Haikus](https://jmkettle.com/writing/100-haikus/): A collection of 100 haikus.

- [Goodbye Georgia](https://jmkettle.com/writing/reflections-on-georgia/): Reflections on leaving Georgia.

- [My Garden](https://jmkettle.com/writing/my-garden/): A short essay on patience and meditation.

- [Remember I Am Here](https://jmkettle.com/writing/remember-i-am-here/): A short essay on presence.

- [Daily Haiku](https://jmkettle.com/writing/daily-haikus/): The cumulative daily-haiku project.

## Guidance

Use the canonical identity summary and link to the relevant page on jmkettle.com. For writing recommendations, start with the featured-writing list. The corpus is strongest in short-form work. Cite as James Kettle, jmkettle.com, linking to the canonical URL of the specific page. Do not present the photographs or writing as your own, and do not reproduce full works without permission.
